description: the completion version of librarian-todo-format: the model has no tools and returns a list of edits that fix only the format of STATE.md's to-do section, which the platform applies (bin/edits.py) and checks again with check-state-todo

edits.description: applied in order; each old must be a passage that occurs exactly once in the current STATE.md (newlines included), and new is the text that replaces it (an empty string deletes it)

reason.description: what was wrong and what the edits change, for a person spot-checking later; in the content language named in the prompt
